incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated page fired: latency_slo.p99 > 2500ms for route /v1/generate (eu-west). alert_id=ALERT-2790. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/inference/alerts/2790
Priya: acked — Priya here, taking ownership.
Priya: quick glance shows queue depth jump on the batcher and KV cache eviction spikes.
Mateo: fyi I pushed a canary of redwood-quant-v2 at 14:03 UTC to eu-west, could be related.
Priya: @Mateo which canary config? any changed quant params?
Mateo: turned on mixed-int8 path + aggressive chunking. rolling back now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/quant-model -n inference`.
Sam: I'm scaling up batcher workers and pausing cluster autoscaler to avoid oscillation: `kubectl scale deploy/batcher --replicas=6 -n inference`
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: page was delivered to rotation; acknowledged by Priya at 2790012352.
Lin: Customer impact? are we seeing increased 5xx or just latency?
Nora: CS: a few EU customers reported timeouts and slow responses in the last 10m, not a widespread outage but multiple tickets.
Priya: Mitigation in progress: rollback started, suppressing KV eviction, warming prefix cache. ETA 6-8m to see p99 improvements.
Mateo: rollback finished, restarting sidecars on pods that hit the quant path. logs earlier contained `OOM while allocating 1.2 GiB` on quant kernel.
Sam: metrics are trending down — p99 dropped from 2600ms -> ~1100ms after rollback and scale. still monitoring for stability.
incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved: p99 < 1500ms for 5m at 2790012625.
Priya: handing off for follow-up: @Sam please own the RCA and postmortem. initial notes: quant config too aggressive + autoscaler interaction with batcher caused queue amplification.
Sam: ack — will open RFC and postmortem ticket, ping affected customers with a summary.
Priya: thanks team. leaving channel but reachable if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
